scientific_integrity: Underlying primary/secondary orbital probability formulae are established. The one-moment mixture and identifiability law has only self-review. Literature search is nonexhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Ideal conjunction geometry, uniform independent orientation and periapsis angle, an unsaturated positive planet-to-orbit geometric factor, no photometric or survey completeness effects. Establishes a selected-angle population identity and nonidentifiability, not historical priority or empirical measurement.
title: An exact one-moment limit on eccentricity inference from double eclipses
